name: Podcast Hook Captions
summary: Turn a podcast Draft into an editable short-form reel: yellow word-pop captions, kinetic hook titles, a warm punch-in look, optional B-roll and synced sound effects.

compatibility.selects: Selects 2.0.560 or later with the public selects.ai SDK, plus selects-ai-runtime installed from the same library commit. Shared YuNet inference uses native CPU on macOS and Windows. Full paid reel generation is not part of this migration verification.

de.name: Podcast-Hook-Untertitel
de.summary: Macht aus einem Podcast-Draft einen bearbeitbaren Kurzclip: gelbe Wort-für-Wort-Untertitel, kinetische Hook-Titel, ein warmer Punch-in-Look, optionale B-Roll und synchrone Soundeffekte.

en.name: Podcast Hook Captions
en.summary: Turn a podcast Draft into an editable short-form reel: yellow word-pop captions, kinetic hook titles, a warm punch-in look, optional B-roll and synced sound effects.

es.name: Subtítulos gancho para pódcast
es.summary: Convierte un Draft de pódcast en un clip corto editable: subtítulos amarillos palabra a palabra, títulos gancho cinéticos, un look cálido con zoom, B-roll opcional y efectos de sonido sincronizados.

fr.name: Sous-titres accroche podcast
fr.summary: Transforme un Draft de podcast en clip court modifiable : sous-titres jaunes mot à mot, titres d'accroche animés, un look chaud avec zooms, B-roll en option et effets sonores synchronisés.

it.name: Sottotitoli hook per podcast
it.summary: Trasforma un Draft di podcast in un clip breve modificabile: sottotitoli gialli parola per parola, titoli hook cinetici, un look caldo con zoom, B-roll opzionale ed effetti sonori sincronizzati.

ja.name: ポッドキャスト・フック字幕
ja.summary: ポッドキャストのDraftを編集可能なショート動画に仕上げます。単語ごとに弾む黄色の字幕、動きのあるフックタイトル、暖色のパンチインルック、任意のBロール、同期した効果音が入ります。

ko.name: 팟캐스트 훅 자막
ko.summary: 팟캐스트 Draft를 편집 가능한 숏폼 릴로 만듭니다. 단어마다 튀어나오는 노란 자막, 움직이는 훅 타이틀, 따뜻한 펀치인 룩, 선택형 B롤, 싱크된 효과음이 들어갑니다.

pt.name: Legendas de gancho para podcast
pt.summary: Transforma um Draft de podcast num clipe curto editável: legendas amarelas palavra a palavra, títulos de gancho cinéticos, um visual quente com zoom, B-roll opcional e efeitos sonoros sincronizados.

tr.name: Podcast Kanca Altyazıları
tr.summary: Bir podcast Draft'ını düzenlenebilir kısa videoya dönüştürür: kelime kelime beliren sarı altyazılar, hareketli kanca başlıkları, sıcak yakınlaştırma görünümü, isteğe bağlı B-roll ve senkron ses efektleri.

zh.name: 播客钩子字幕
zh.summary: 把播客 Draft 做成可编辑的短视频：逐词弹出的黄色字幕、动态钩子标题、暖色推近效果、可选 B-roll，以及同步的音效。
